payload.description: How much the council's government funding has risen or fallen in real terms since 2019/20. Answering that needs the government's Core Spending Power tables for each year, which are national statistics rather than council papers and are not in this archive. Without them we can show what the council received but not what it is worth. It is the single most-asked question about council finances and we cannot answer it yet.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
